purpose: Define project-site installation, commissioning, handover and service-baseline evidence for VX4800 without treating factory acceptance, repository validation or visual inspection as site acceptance.

controlledBaseline.sitePrimarySupport: engineered building structure through approved project-specific interface

requirements: Verify shipment identity, fixture serial/build configuration, package count and dispatch documentation.
Inspect shipping restraints, visible finishes, butterflies, suspension lines and safety-critical hardware for transport damage.
Quarantine and NCR any damage or identity mismatch before installation.
Confirm named-project structural approval and interface coordinates before permanent load transfer.
Verify actual supporting structure matches approved project information or obtain approved disposition.
Install exact approved support/anchor/connection system with recorded inspection and installation values where specified.
Verify independent secondary-retention structural termination before normal operation.
Maintain component and element identity through unpacking and assembly.
Install canopy, suspension, butterflies and kinetic components using released work instructions.
Verify exact 240-element schedule, line identity/length, attachment orientation and lower-edge envelope.
Complete inaccessible-before-close inspections before decorative closure.
Verify market/project supply, protective devices, isolation, earthing/bonding and wiring against released electrical authority.
Verify all 14 fixed accent heads and exact released optic/CCT configuration.
Commission DALI-2 or other released control architecture without changing physical optical roles or safety limits.
Record addressing, groups/scenes, control-gear identity and functional test results.
Complete post-install electrical safety checks required by the released installation/test plan.
Verify mechanical service lock, brake/holding architecture, secondary retention and feedback hardware before powered motion.
Confirm the field is clear of people, temporary works, packaging and obstructions before each initial motion test.
Commission at released low-speed/jog condition before nominal operation.
Verify released direction, speed limits, controlled stop, fault stop, power-loss behavior, safe restart and abnormal-torque response.
Verify no unacceptable contact, snagging, cable interaction, head interference or architectural collision during site trials.
Do not widen software limits to make an installation fit; treat interference as an engineering nonconformance.
Record final installed configuration and all approved site deviations.
Record commissioning baselines for motion, lighting, noise/vibration observations and inspection condition.
Demonstrate isolation and mechanical service-lock procedure to authorized service personnel.
Provide installation, operation, inspection, maintenance and replacement instructions plus spare-part identities.
Establish owner/operator contacts, warranty/service process, first planned inspection and change-control requirements.

preconditions.requirement: Named project/configuration has approved construction release under the VX4800 release-gate framework.
Project structural/site-interface design and support system are approved.
Delivered fixture configuration is traceable to the released manufacturing build and FAT/pre-hang evidence.
Released kinetic architecture, limits and commissioning procedure are available.
Released electrical/head/control-gear configuration and market supply design are available.
Site access, lifting/temporary works, exclusion zone and installation method are approved.

installationEvidence.requirement: Shipment/receipt inspection confirms identity, quantity, condition and NCR disposition before installation.
Installed structural interfaces, supports/connections and secondary-retention termination match the named-project approved structural design.
Installed fixture serial/build configuration, 240-element schedule, 14 fixed heads and safety-critical components match released authority or approved deviations.
Supply, protection, isolation, bonding, wiring, control gear and fixed-head configuration are verified on site.
Exact released head/optic/CCT configuration, addressing and intended control groups/scenes are commissioned and recorded.
Released kinetic limits, feedback, stops, power-loss behavior, safe restart, service lock and abnormal-motion response are demonstrated on site.
Site motion trials demonstrate no unacceptable interference with butterflies, cables, fixed heads, canopy, architecture or services across released commissioning conditions.
Final as-installed record, manuals, service procedure, baseline condition, training/handover and open-item register are controlled.

rules: A successful factory FAT/pre-hang does not close site installation or commissioning evidence.
Permanent support must transfer into the named-project approved building structure, not false-ceiling framing or decorative skin.
A site interference is an engineering issue; commissioning software limits must not be expanded or shifted merely to hide it.
Any failed commissioning result remains failed until disposition and affected re-test are complete.
The as-installed configuration and approved deviations become part of the service baseline for future maintenance and changes.
Blender renders, coordination geometry and GitHub CI cannot close physical installation evidence.
